// diagnostic

E0302

Unknown field (with suggestion)

What

Unknown field (with suggestion)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Use the suggested field name or declare the intended field.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0302: tests/ui/cffi_callback_bound_method.stderr.

Error [jet.NonCAbiType]: `fn(I32) -[]> I32` is not a C-compatible type for a foreign function parameter or return.
  --> tests/ui/cffi_callback_bound_method.jet:15:22
    |
 15 |     print(c.call(inc.apply, 1))
    |                      ^^^^^
 Why: `#Import` / `#Export` functions must use types with a stable C ABI at the edge.
 Fix: Use scalars, `String`, or a struct with C layout; pointers only through the gated tier.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E3203

Error [jet.UnknownField]: `Incrementer` has no field `apply`
  --> tests/ui/cffi_callback_bound_method.jet:15:22
    |
 15 |     print(c.call(inc.apply, 1))
    |                      ^^^^^
 Why: Field access only works on names declared in the struct
 Fix: Check the field names on `Incrementer`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0302
